access_boundary: This record represents the preview release identified by the undated model code gemini-3-flash-preview (latest update December 2025; knowledge cutoff January 2025; inputs text, image, video, audio, PDF; output text). There is no dated snapshot behind the ID and no shutdown date announced; Google recommends gemini-3.5-flash or gemini-3.6-flash for new production use. The stable successors, Gemini 3 Pro previews, image-generation and audio variants, the Gemini consumer app, and the Vertex AI and AI Studio platforms themselves are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a distinct model code, full modality matrix including computer use, token limits, update date, and knowledge cutoff
The release is corroborated across the API changelog, the deprecations table, Vertex AI release notes, and a DeepMind model-cards entry
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The undated preview ID carries only a two-week deprecation guarantee with no committed shutdown date
